part1_meanpool_all_clips_note: Part 1 mean-pooled values on ALL 1,500 direction clips (1,200 train / 300 test), not on this run's 750-clip constant-velocity subset (596 train / 154 test); a cross-reference only, not a same-clip baseline (the meanpool_r2 curve in `curves` is the same-clip baseline). Key relabelled from part1_meanpool in the QA3 audit; values unchanged.
left_positions: columns 0-7 of the 16x16 grid (128 positions); right = columns 8-15

methods.probe: closed-form ridge as wm.probes: train-standardised features, targets (sin, cos), alpha by fold-mean R2 on the split's 5 train folds over ALPHAS = logspace(-2, 4, 13), refit on all train, test scored once
methods.meanpool: position mean of the stored time-pool (= Part 1 meanpool up to fp16 storage), same recipe
methods.perpos: one probe per spatial position, own standardiser and own CV alpha (no alpha sharing)
methods.pooled: one probe on all (train clip, position) samples (n_train x 256), standardised over those samples, folds by clip; test scored per position
methods.halves: pooled probe fit on the left (right) 128 positions of train clips; within = same half of test clips, cross = other half; R2 over all (clip, position) samples of that half; cross_half_r2 = mean of left->right and right->left
methods.r2: mean over the sin and cos columns of per-column R2 on test clips
methods.onset: first SAMPLED point with metric >= 90% of its max over the sampled points; 95% CI from a 200-draw bootstrap of test clips over fixed test predictions (Part 1's CV onset used train-fold OOF predictions; the meanpool_r2 curve here gives the same-rule test-set baseline)

memmap.pooling: mean over the 8 token time steps; positions kept (16x16, index h*16 + w, w = column)

extraction.preprocess: wm.extract: 16 frames, 256 px, ImageNet mean/std, no resize/crop, fp32 forward, TF32 off

provenance.pooling: mean over the 8 token time steps; positions kept (16x16, index h*16 + w, w = column)
provenance.host: vast 53030966 RTX 4060 Ti (extract GPU; per-position probes CPU float64; pooled/half probes GPU fp32 grams with float64 sums, float64 eigh)
provenance.subset: constant-velocity clips only (motion == 'velocity'), split rows filtered, same folds
provenance.time_averaging: per-position features are averaged over the 8 token time steps before probing (one 1024-vector per spatial position per clip); the paper does not state whether its per-patch probes use per-token or time-averaged features
provenance.half_frame_design: the half-frame test fits ONE pooled probe over the 128 positions of one half (columns 0-7 or 8-15; every (clip, position) is a sample) and scores it on the other half's positions of test clips; the paper does not state its half-frame probe design
